description:
Rewire the existing fading and interleaving path so it uses the shared modem abstractions instead of bespoke QPSK-specific modem logic.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] The current Rician fading link can use the shared modem surface for modulation and demapping.
- [ ] Existing interleaving and fading composition still works with the migrated modem pipeline.
- [ ] The resulting path no longer depends on a unique QPSK-only modem implementation.

## Notes

This task closes the simulation integration story by bringing the current fading pipeline onto the shared surface.
title: Adapt the Rician fading link to the common modem surface
